name: zfmv_action_run_blocking_timed
description: zFMV_Action::RunBlockingTimed begins the action at time zero, repeatedly calls the action update slot with elapsed seconds from GetTickCount until it returns 0, then calls the action end slot.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zFMV action/source-file pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4159e0 validates the thiscall body: capture the start tick via GetTickCount, call vtable slot 0x08 Begin with 0.0, call vtable slot 0x04 Update with elapsed seconds until it returns zero, then call vtable slot 0x0c End.
The dependency frontier has no authored source blockers: GetTickCount is an imported runtime wrapper and the indirect calls target the established zFMV action vtable slots.

The native smoke uses the recovered zFMV action vtable contract to verify Begin, Update, and End are called once in order for the zero-update path, with Begin receiving 0.0 and Update receiving a non-negative elapsed time.
